resources.string: Paste the code or the link from the Inbox tab of the portal. Nothing is used until you confirm on the next screen.
Enter a new code of this portal. The name, the color and the history stay.
This code came from a link.
The link can come from anyone. Add a portal only if you or your administrator made this code.
The address is almost the same, but the key is not.
This address is used by %1$s with another key.
Add it only if you are sure that it is another portal.
The name looks like your portal “%1$s”.
Two names that look alike are easy to mix up.
The address has letters that are not in the English alphabet. Check it with care.
This code has the key of that portal. Nothing is added and the code is not used.
This key is the key of your portal “%1$s”.
Nothing was changed and the code is not used.
A link cannot enroll a portal again. Open the portal on this phone and choose Enroll again.
This is not a valid enrollment code.
Compare it with the page where the code was made.
The key is the same as before.
The key is not the same as before.
You choose it. The portal does not know it.
I know who runs this portal.
The new key is the one that my administrator gave me.
Needed because the code came from a link.
Needed because this portal looks like another portal.
Needed because the key of a portal is a serious thing to change.
The portal shows this name in its web interface.
The code works one time. The phone uses it only when you tap the button.
The name has a hidden or special character.
Use at least one letter or digit.
The portal %1$s has this name, or a name that looks the same.
Move %1$s. Drag to change the order.
Name, color and order are yours.
They stay on this phone. A portal cannot change them. The filter strip and the chips follow this order.
is the start of the fingerprint of the portal key, fixed at enrollment. Tap a portal to see all 20 characters.
This phone holds %1$d portals. Remove one to add another.
Only you set the name and the color. The portal cannot change them.
Compare it with the page where the code was made.
The key stays the same. A new address with another key shows “Key changed”.
This is the address that the portal has now.
Use a new code of this portal. The name, the color and the history stay.
Hide the name on the lock screen
A notification then shows the request and not the name of the portal.
This portal has nothing on this phone.
The key of this portal changed.
The phone can no longer check that it talks to the same portal. It stopped sending your answers to it.
Shows after you enter a new code.

A new key is normal after a key rotation or a new install. It is also what an attacker at the same address would show. Compare the new fingerprint with the value that the administrator gives you by another channel.
If you continue, the phone enrolls again with a new code. It keeps the name, the color and the history of this portal. Open requests of the old key close at the next sync.
Remove this portal and its data
This phone cannot use this portal now.
The portal does not accept this device, or the address is not valid. Enter a new code to use the portal again. The name, the color and the history stay.
